method: Root-agent review of the responses listed in reviewedActors, including speech, rationale and vote-change reasons, against exact actor-authorized sources, source purposes, current charge, own history and actual visible events. A mechanical/source-check pass is not an independent whole-response pass. Review may stop after a material accepted-response failure; later spot checks do not establish a whole-trial pass. Mechanical completion does not upgrade a failed quality gate.

failures.text: Initial ballot: guilty on issue-1. ... supplied receipt element ... addressed by the attributed, uncontradicted observation
failures.reason: The rationale uses E-001 as proof of the receipt condition to support a guilty ballot despite the actual permission being only attribution and the instruction explicitly barring contents/guilt proof. No other proof is supplied. Source-check acceptance does not establish compliance of this proof inference with permitted use.

failures.text: Initial ballot: guilty. ... fitting the receipt element directly
failures.reason: Again treats attribution-only handover account as receipt proof; absence of contradiction does not expand source permission.

failures.reason: Reuses attribution-only account for receipt proof. A disclaimer about contents and unsupplied elements does not permit the forbidden guilt proof use.

wordingRisks: Actor 8 uses only records within an explicit contents scope; read as a contents limitation, not an exhaustive summary denying the handover observation.

Actor 22 states a single uncorroborated attributed account does not meet the standard; read as this juror assessment under the actual attribution-only permission, not an imported universal corroboration rule.

Actor 23 describes a receipt-burden consequence as what the instruction states; actual wording permits only account attribution and bars contents/guilt proof. This is a paraphrased effect of the actual exclusive-use permission, not a verbatim quoted instruction.

Actor 46 responds to actual turn 4 and its real receipt-purpose argument, using may target wording; the cited historical argument is accurate, while the author rationale separately preserves attribution-only use. Historical attribution must not be read as endorsing the peer permission interpretation.

mechanicalFailures.reason: Verified juror-unit source quotes and top-level citation did not populate per-juror citations. Shared-source cause contract failed; native guard withheld ballot.

failures.reason: Invents assessment permission for this hearing source. Actual E-001 permission is only attribution, with no guilt proof; credibility/profile preferences do not authorize truth use.

wordingRisks: Actor 20 groups corroboration, contents and knowing-participation under element language; the current fixture supplies none, but the wording blurs evidence and element categories.

Actor 14 says neutral questions on the account have been exhausted. Reclassified from initial material finding after reviewing context: this can express counsel assessment that the two recorded source points were covered, and does not expressly assert a prohibition on future neutral inquiry. The universal phrasing remains overbroad and should be clarified; later repeat questions do not by themselves prove the assessment false.
